# 2.4.10 Section Headings (Level AAA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.4 Navigable
- Level: AAA
- Versions: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/section-headings.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#section-headings

## Normative text

[Section](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-section) headings are used to organize the content.

> **Note 1:** "Heading" is used in its general sense and includes titles and other ways to add a heading to different types of content.

> **Note 2:** This success criterion covers sections within writing, not [user interface components](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-user-interface-components). User interface components are covered under [Success Criterion 4.1.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#name-role-value).

## Sufficient techniques

- G141: Organizing a page using headings
- H69: Providing heading elements at the beginning of each section of content
